evidence.detail: archetype_key_cards = playability.key_cards_long(season_id) fetches ALL archetypes for the season before pagination; only results from the current page are then used
key_cards_long queries the full _season_archetype_playability table with no archetype_id filter; returns a dict keyed by every archetype_id in the season

triage.fix_sketch: Add an optional archetype_ids: list[int] | None = None parameter to key_cards_long() in decksite/data/playability.py; when provided, append AND p.archetype_id IN (<ids>) to the WHERE clause. In decksite/controllers/api.py:450, pass [r.id for r in results] as the new argument so only the current page's archetypes are fetched.
triage.notes: Author's own comment says the query is likely fast already; the fix is a correctness/hygiene improvement but the performance win may be modest.
